concerns.client_id_authority: Google Auth Platform OAuth client registration metadata plus the environment-scoped GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID resolver variable.
concerns.client_secret_authority: Google Auth Platform client-secret issuance with write-only binding to the environment-scoped Cloudflare Worker secret GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.
concerns.provider_application_registration_author: Google Auth Platform OAuth client registration owned outside repository state; repository evidence contains metadata only.
concerns.redirect_configuration_authority: Google Auth Platform authorized redirect-URI metadata matched exactly to the environment-scoped GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI resolver variable.
provider_metadata_evidence: client-secret creation/status metadata without secret value
retirement_preconditions: target OAuth client id and authorized redirect URI metadata match the intended environment
replacement client secret is added and enabled while the previous secret remains enabled
replacement secret is write-only bound to GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET for the intended resolver environment
bounded staging authorization-code and refresh-token exchanges succeed with the replacement
metadata-only rollout evidence confirms the previous secret is no longer used before disable
previous secret is disabled only after replacement verification and deleted only after a bounded rollback observation window
concerns.recovery: If replacement verification fails before deletion, keep the previous secret enabled or re-enable it after disable, restore the previous Worker binding, and repeat verification. Deletion is final for that secret; user OAuth state remains solely under AR-8A.

concerns.redirect_configuration_authority: Microsoft Entra Web redirect-URI registration matched exactly to the environment-scoped MICROSOFT_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI resolver variable.
provider_metadata_evidence: application object id and appId/client id
retirement_preconditions: target application client id and registered Web redirect URI metadata match the intended environment
replacement passwordCredential is added before removal of the previous credential
replacement secretText is captured only at issuance and write-only bound to MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET for the intended resolver environment
bounded staging authorization-code and refresh-token exchanges succeed with the replacement
replacement passwordCredential keyId and endDateTime metadata are recorded without secret value readback
previous passwordCredential is removed by keyId only after replacement verification
concerns.recovery: If replacement verification fails, keep the previous passwordCredential valid and restore the previous Worker binding. If a passwordCredential has already been removed, it is not treated as recoverable secret material; issue a new replacement. User refresh-token lifecycle remains AR-8A authority.
